title: FuzzReport
description: Differential fuzzing report detailing execution metrics, detected behavioral divergences, and promoted test cases.

unit_id.description: Migration unit identifier targeted by the differential fuzzer.

total_runs.description: Total number of generated fuzzed input executions.

divergences_count.description: Number of inputs where original and ported outputs differed.

divergences.description: Detailed records of behavioral discrepancies detected during fuzzing.

case_id.description: Identifier of the divergent fuzz case.

input.description: Mutated input payload that triggered the divergence.

legacy_output.description: Output produced by the original legacy implementation.

modern_output.description: Output produced by the modern Go implementation.

diff.description: Difference details or unified diff representation.

promoted_count.description: Number of divergent cases promoted and appended to durable test cases.

promoted_cases.description: List of case IDs promoted to the regression corpus.

corpus_path.description: Path to the seed corpus or durable cases file.

passed.description: Whether fuzzing completed without detecting any behavioral divergences.
